title: Tiny, cute bell
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bellBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#FFC61A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#D98E00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bellShine' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF6C4' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFF6C4' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- hanging loop -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='3.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#FFE9A8' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- bell body -->
  <path d='M50 26
           C36 26 27 38 26 52
           C25 60 24 64 21 69
           C19 73 20 76 24 77
           L76 77
           C80 76 81 73 79 69
           C76 64 75 60 74 52
           C73 38 64 26 50 26 Z'
        fill='url(#bellBody)'/>

  <!-- soft highlight -->
  <path d='M50 28
           C40 28 33 36 31 47
           C30 52 29 56 27 60
           C26 62 27 63 29 63
           C31 63 31 60 32 56
           C34 45 40 33 50 33 Z'
        fill='url(#bellShine)'/>

  <!-- rim band -->
  <rect x='21' y='70' width='58' height='8' rx='4' fill='#FFD24D'/>
  <rect x='21' y='70' width='58' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#FFF0B0'/>

  <!-- clapper -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='6.5' fill='#E8A800'/>
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='79.5' r='2.2' fill='#FFE9A8' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- little sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#FFF6C4' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='48' r='1.4' fill='#FFF6C4' opacity='0.75'/>
</svg>
